caption: The drawing depicts an ornately framed mirror with a rectangular shape and decorative elements above and below the glass. The frame is depicted in shades of brown and gold, suggesting a wood material with gilded accents. At the top center of the frame is a round medallion containing a painted scene of a landscape, featuring a castle-like building on a hill, trees, and a path, rendered in muted blue, green, and earth tones. Above this medallion is an elaborate decorative crest consisting of a gold-colored vase from which symmetrical, curling foliage and leaf motifs sprout. The upper corners of the frame feature gold and brown scrollwork, and the midsections of each side of the frame display rectangular black sections each containing a white oval medallion. The lower section of the mirror is accentuated by additional gold ornamentation, with a motif of interlaced arches and a central, radiating design. The main body of the mirror is a vertical rectangle with a light blue and white gradient suggesting reflective glass. The name "Wellington Slewett" appears in small text in the lower right corner of the drawing. The background is plain and light beige.
title: Mirror
